title: Introduction
text: This specification is organised as follows:
a) clause 4.2 describes the RRC protocol model;
b) clause 4.3 specifies the services provided to upper layers as well as the services expected from lower layers;
c) clause 4.4 lists the RRC functions;
d) clause 5 specifies RRC procedures, including UE state transitions;
e) clause 6 specifies the RRC messages in ASN.1 and description;
f) clause 7 specifies the variables (including protocol timers and constants) and counters to be used by the UE;
g) clause 8 specifies the encoding of the RRC messages;
h) clause 9 specifies the specified and default radio configurations;
i) clause 10 specifies generic error handling;
j) clause 11 specifies the RRC messages transferred across network nodes;
k) clause 12 specifies the UE capability related constraints and performance requirements.
